parsed.rationale: Both participating records have `is_test: true` and reside in the same test file `Shared/Playback/Tests/PlaybackTests/Behavior/AudioPlayerBehaviorTests.swift` within the `Playback` package. Although the two methods `stopTransitionsToIdle` (line 71) and `isPlayingFalseAfterStop` (line 88) share a high Jaccard similarity of ~0.78, they are distinct test cases asserting different observable post-conditions of a stop operation — one verifying state transition to idle, the other verifying the `isPlaying` flag — and their structural similarity is a natural consequence of testing the same system under test with similar setup. Collapsing them would obscure test intent and reduce diagnostic clarity on failure.
